title: Australian house prices drop for sixth straight month with falls of up to 15 per cent expected
desc: Australian house prices fell for a sixth straight month in September, and the property market is likely to continue experiencing falls of up to 15 per cent in the coming months off the back of higher interest rates and cuts to property tax breaks, experts say.
source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation

title: Ex-Brazil forward Pato joins Northampton board after takeover
desc: Former Brazil and AC Milan forward Alexandre Pato has joined the board of Northampton Town after a consortium including the retired footballer completed its takeover of the English League Two club.

title: New AI framework personalizes supportive care for cancer survivors
desc: Researchers with Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, have created a framework for developing, evaluating and implementing AI tools in cancer survivorship and supportive care, according to a new proof-of-concept study published in the journal Translational Behavioral Medicine.
